verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַת הָעֲשִׂרִ֔ית לְצִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֧יא הַשָּׁנָ֛ה שְׁמֹנֶֽה־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh biš·naṯ hā·‘ă·śi·rîṯ lə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh hî haš·šā·nāh šə·mō·neh- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lin·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah which was the eighteenth . . . . . . year of Nebuchadnezzar
verses.literalPt: A palavra que da parte de Jeová veio a Jeremias no décimo ano de Zedequias, rei de Judá, o qual ano era o décimo oitavo de Nabucodonosor.

verses.original: וְאָ֗ז חֵ֚יל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא הָיָ֤ה כָלוּא֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּֽית־ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’āz ḥêl me·leḵ bā·ḇel ṣā·rîm ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî hā·yāh ḵā·lū ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh ’ă·šer bêṯ- me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging . . . Jerusalem and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard which was in the palace of the king of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora nesse tempo cercava o exército do rei de Babilônia a Jerusalém; e o profeta Jeremias se achava encarcerado no pátio da guarda, que estava na casa do rei de Judá.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּלָא֔וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ אַתָּ֨ה נִבָּ֜א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֜ן אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer kə·lā·’ōw ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr mad·dū·a‘ ’at·tāh nib·bā lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯên ’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵā·ḏāh
verses.literal: For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him saying Why are you prophesying like this You claim that the LORD says Behold I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will capture it
verses.literalPt: Pois Zedequias, rei de Judá, o havia encerrado, dizendo: Porque profetizas tu e dizes: Assim diz Jeová: Eis que entregarei esta cidade nas mãos do rei de Babilônia, e ele a tomará;

verses.original: וְצִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵ֖ט מִיַּ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י הִנָּתֹ֤ן יִנָּתֵן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְדִבֶּר־ פִּ֣יו עִם־ פִּ֔יו וְעֵינָ֖יו אֶת־ עֵינוֹ תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh lō yim·mā·lêṭ mî·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm kî hin·nā·ṯōn yin·nā·ṯên bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wə·ḏib·ber- pîw ‘im- pîw wə·‘ê·nāw ’eṯ- ʿē·nō tir·’e·nāh
verses.literal: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans but he will surely be delivered . . . into the hand of the king of Babylon and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye
verses.literalPt: e Zedequias, rei de Judá, não escapará das mãos dos caldeus, mas certamente será entregue nas mãos do rei de Babilônia, e falará com ele boca a boca, e os seus olhos verão os olhos dele;

verses.original: וּבָבֶ֞ל יוֹלִ֤ךְ אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וְשָׁ֣ם יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַד־ פָּקְדִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֧י תִֽלָּחֲמ֛וּ אֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ḇel yō·w·liḵ ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū wə·šām yih·yeh ‘aḏ- pā·qə·ḏî ’ō·ṯōw nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ṯil·lā·ḥă·mū ’eṯ- hak·kaś·dîm lō ṯaṣ·lî·ḥū
verses.literal: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon where he will stay until I attend to him declares the LORD If you fight against the Chaldeans you will not succeed
verses.literalPt: e o rei de Babilônia levará para Babilônia Zedequias que ali estará até que eu o visite, diz Jeová? Ainda que pelejeis contra os caldeus, não sereis bem sucedidos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הָיָ֥ה דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū hā·yāh də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Jeremiah replied The word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeremias: A palavra de Jeová veio a mim, dizendo:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה חֲנַמְאֵ֗ל בֶּן־ שַׁלֻּם֙ דֹּֽדְךָ֔ בָּ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר קְנֵ֣ה לְךָ֗ אֶת־ שָׂדִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִקְנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḥă·nam·’êl ben- šal·lum dō·ḏə·ḵā bā ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr qə·nêh lə·ḵā ’eṯ- śā·ḏî ’ă·šer ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ kî lə·ḵā miš·paṭ hag·gə·’ul·lāh liq·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Behold Hanamel the son of your uncle Shallum is coming to you to say Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth for you have the right of redemption to buy it
verses.literalPt: Eis que Hananeel, filho de Salum, teu tio, virá a ti, dizendo: Compra-te o meu campo que está em Anatote; pois a ti, a quem pertence o direito de resgate, compete comprá-lo.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לַי חֲנַמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־ דֹּדִ֜י כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ חֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י קְנֵ֣ה נָ֠א אֶת־ שָׂדִ֨י אֲשֶׁר־ בַּעֲנָת֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ין כִּֽי־ לְךָ֞ מִשְׁפַּ֧ט הַיְרֻשָּׁ֛ה וּלְךָ֥ הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה קְנֵה־ לָ֑ךְ וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ê·lay ḥă·nam·’êl ben- dō·ḏî kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’el- ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay qə·nêh nā ’eṯ- śā·ḏî ’ă·šer- ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·mîn kî- lə·ḵā miš·paṭ hay·ruš·šāh ū·lə·ḵā hag·gə·’ul·lāh qə·nêh- lāḵ wā·’ê·ḏa‘ kî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: Then, as the LORD . . . had said my cousin . . . Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me . . . Please buy my field in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin for you own the right of inheritance and redemption Buy it for yourself Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Veio, pois, segundo a palavra de Jeová, ter comigo no pátio da guarda Hananeel, filho do meu tio, e disse-me: Compra o meu campo que está em Anatote, na terra de Benjamim; porque teu é o direito da herança, e a ti pertence o resgatá-lo; compra-o para ti. Entendi que era isto a palavra de Jeová.

verses.original: וָֽאֶקְנֶה֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵאֵ֛ת חֲנַמְאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ דֹּדִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֑וֹת וָֽאֶשְׁקֲלָה־ לּוֹ֙ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים וַעֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·neh ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh mê·’êṯ ḥă·nam·’êl ben- dō·ḏî ’ă·šer ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ wā·’eš·qă·lāh- lōw ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ šiḇ·‘āh šə·qā·lîm wa·‘ă·śā·rāh hak·kā·sep̄
verses.literal: So I bought the field . . . in Anathoth from my cousin . . . Hanamel and I weighed out seventeen . . . shekels of silver
verses.literalPt: Comprei o campo que estava em Anatote a Hananeel, filho de meu tio, e pesei-lhe o dinheiro, dezesseis siclos de prata.

verses.original: וָאֶכְתֹּ֤ב בַּסֵּ֙פֶר֙ וָֽאֶחְתֹּ֔ם וָאָעֵ֖ד עֵדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁקֹ֥ל הַכֶּ֖סֶף בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḵ·tōḇ bas·sê·p̄er wā·’eḥ·tōm wā·’ā·‘êḏ ‘ê·ḏîm wā·’eš·qōl hak·ke·sep̄ bə·mō·zə·nā·yim
verses.literal: I signed and sealed the deed called in witnesses . . . and weighed out the silver on the scales
verses.literalPt: Subscrevi o auto e o selei, chamei testemunhas e pesei-lhe o dinheiro numa balança.

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֖ח אֶת־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה אֶת־ הֶֽחָת֛וּם הַמִּצְוָ֥ה וְהַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַגָּלֽוּי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṯūm ham·miṣ·wāh wə·ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·’eṯ- hag·gā·lui
verses.literal: Then I took the deed of purchase the sealed copy with its terms and conditions as well as the open copy
verses.literalPt: Tomei o auto da compra, tanto o selado, que continha o mandado e as condições, como o aberto.

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֞ן אֶת־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֗ה אֶל־ בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־ מַחְסֵיָה֒ לְעֵינֵי֙ חֲנַמְאֵ֣ל דֹּדִ֔י וּלְעֵינֵי֙ הָֽעֵדִ֔ים הַכֹּתְבִ֖ים בְּסֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה לְעֵינֵי֙ כָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ’el- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh ben- maḥ·sê·yāh lə·‘ê·nê ḥă·nam·’êl dō·ḏî ū·lə·‘ê·nê hā·‘ê·ḏîm hak·kō·ṯə·ḇîm bə·sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: and I gave this deed . . . to Baruch son of Neriah the son of Mahseiah in the sight of my cousin . . . Hanamel and the witnesses who were signing the purchase . . . agreement and all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard
verses.literalPt: O auto da compra entreguei a Baruque, filho de Nerias, filho de Maaseias, na presença de Hananeel, filho de meu tio, e na presença das testemunhas que subscreveram o auto da compra, à vista de todos os judeus que estavam sentados no pátio da guarda.

verses.original: וָֽאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת בָּר֔וּךְ לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ṣaw·weh ʾɛṯ bā·rūḵ lə·‘ê·nê·hem lê·mōr
verses.literal: In their sight . . . I instructed Baruch
verses.literalPt: Dei ordem a Baruque diante deles, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָק֣וֹחַ אֶת־ הַסְּפָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה אֵ֣ת סֵפֶר֩ הַמִּקְנָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת הֶחָת֗וּם וְאֵ֨ת סֵ֤פֶר הַגָּלוּי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בִּכְלִי־ חָ֑רֶשׂ לְמַ֥עַן יַעַמְד֖וּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lā·qō·w·aḥ ’eṯ- has·sə·p̄ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’êṯ sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh haz·zeh wə·’êṯ he·ḥā·ṯūm wə·’êṯ sê·p̄er hag·gā·lui haz·zeh ū·nə·ṯat·tām biḵ·lî- ḥā·reś lə·ma·‘an ya·‘am·ḏū yā·mîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Take these deeds both the sealed copy and the open copy of the deed of purchase and put them in a clay jar to preserve them for a long time
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Toma estes autos, este auto da compra, tanto o selado como o aberto, e mete-os num vaso de barro, para que se possam conservar muitos dias.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֣וֹד יִקָּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֛ים וְשָׂד֥וֹת וּכְרָמִ֖ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·wḏ yiq·qā·nū ḇāt·tîm wə·śā·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḵə·rā·mîm bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Houses fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Ainda se comprarão casas e campos e vinhas nesta terra.

verses.original: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֤י תִתִּי֙ אֶת־ סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֔ה אֶל־ בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh ’a·ḥă·rê ṯit·tî ’eṯ- sê·p̄er ham·miq·nāh ’el- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah . . . I prayed to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ora depois que eu entregara o auto da compra a Baruque, filho de Nerias, orei a Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹֽחֲךָ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה לֹֽא־ יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ bə·ḵō·ḥă·ḵā hag·gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇiz·rō·‘ă·ḵā han·nə·ṭū·yāh lō- yip·pā·lê mim·mə·ḵā kāl- dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Oh Lord GOD . . . You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm Nothing . . . . . . is too difficult for You
verses.literalPt: Ah, Senhor Jeová! tu fizeste o céu e a terra com o teu grande poder e com o teu braço estendido (nada há que seja demasiado difícil para ti);

verses.original: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל־ חֵ֥יק בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַגִּבּ֔וֹר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ la·’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mə·šal·lêm ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ’el- ḥêq bə·nê·hem ’a·ḥă·rê·hem hā·’êl hag·gā·ḏō·wl hag·gib·bō·wr Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: tu mostras misericórdia a milhares, e tornas a iniquidade dos pais ao seio de seus filhos depois deles; tu és o grande, o poderoso Deus, cujo nome é Jeová dos Exércitos,

verses.original: גְּדֹל֙ הָֽעֵצָ֔ה וְרַ֖ב הָעֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ עֵינֶ֣יךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל־ כָּל־ דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְכִפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: gə·ḏōl hā·‘ê·ṣāh wə·raḇ hā·‘ă·lî·lî·yāh ’ă·šer- ‘ê·ne·ḵā p̄ə·qu·ḥō·wṯ ‘al- kāl- dar·ḵê bə·nê ’ā·ḏām lā·ṯêṯ lə·’îš kiḏ·rā·ḵāw wə·ḵip̄·rî ma·‘ă·lā·lāw
verses.literal: the One great in counsel and mighty in deed whose eyes . . . are on all the ways of the sons of men to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds
verses.literalPt: grande em conselho, e poderoso em obras; e cujos olhos estão abertos sobre todos os caminhos dos filhos dos homens; para dares a cada um segundo os seus caminhos, e segundo o fruto dos seus feitos.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּמֹפְתִ֤ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבָֽאָדָ֑ם וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·še·r·śa- śam·tā ’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·mō·p̄ə·ṯîm bə·’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ū·ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇā·’ā·ḏām wat·ta·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā šêm kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt and You do so to this very day both in Israel and among all mankind And You have made a name for Yourself as is the case to this day
verses.literalPt: Tu puseste sinais e maravilhas na terra do Egito até o dia de hoje, e em Israel e entre outros homens; e te fizeste um nome qual tu tens neste dia.

verses.original: וַתֹּצֵ֛א אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֥ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּאֹת֣וֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֗ים וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבְאֶזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָ֖א גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·ṣê ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim bə·’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·ḇə·mō·wp̄·ṯîm ū·ḇə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇə·’ez·rō·w·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇə·mō·w·rā gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror
verses.literalPt: Tu tiraste da terra do Egito o teu povo de Israel com sinais e com maravilhas, e com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com grande terror;

verses.original: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·tên lā·hem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tā la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: You gave them this land that You had sworn to give their fathers a land flowing with milk and honey
verses.literalPt: e deste-lhe esta terra, que juraste a seus pais que lhes darias, terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗הּ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְתֹרוֹתֶךָ לֹא־ הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָהֶ֛ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א עָשׂ֑וּ וַתַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·yir·šū ’ō·ṯāh wə·lō- šā·mə·‘ū ḇə·qō·w·le·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṯō·rō·ṯɛ·ḵå̄ lō- hā·lā·ḵū ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯāh lā·hem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lō ‘ā·śū wat·taq·rê ’ō·ṯām ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: They came in and possessed it but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your law They failed to perform . . . all that You commanded them to do and so You have brought upon them all this disaster
verses.literalPt: Eles entraram, e dela tomaram posse; porém não obedeceram à tua voz, nem andaram na tua lei; não fizeram nada de tudo o que lhes ordenaste fizessem; portanto fizeste que lhes sucedesse todo este mal.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה הַסֹּלְל֗וֹת בָּ֣אוּ הָעִיר֮ לְלָכְדָהּ֒ וְהָעִ֣יר נִתְּנָ֗ה בְּיַ֤ד הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ מִפְּנֵ֛י הַחֶ֥רֶב וְהָרָעָ֖ב וְהַדָּ֑בֶר וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתָּ הָיָ֖ה וְהִנְּךָ֥ רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh has·sō·lə·lō·wṯ bā·’ū hā·‘îr lə·lā·ḵə·ḏāh wə·hā·‘îr nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm han·nil·ḥā·mîm ‘ā·le·hā mip·pə·nê ha·ḥe·reḇ wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ wə·had·dā·ḇer wa·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā hā·yāh wə·hin·nə·ḵā rō·’eh
verses.literal: See how the siege ramps are mounted against the city to capture it And by sword and famine and plague the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it What You have spoken has happened as You now see
verses.literalPt: Eis as trincheiras já são chegadas à cidade para a tomarem, e a cidade, vencida pela espada, pela fome e pela peste, foi entregue nas mãos dos caldeus que pelejam contra ela. O que falaste aconteceu; eis que tu o vês.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ אֵלַי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה קְנֵֽה־ לְךָ֧ הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִ֑ים וְהָעִ֥יר נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lay ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh qə·nêh- lə·ḵā haś·śā·ḏeh bak·ke·sep̄ wə·hā·‘êḏ ‘ê·ḏîm wə·hā·‘îr nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm
verses.literal: Yet You O Lord GOD have said to me Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: Tu, Senhor Jeová, me disseste: Compra o campo por dinheiro, e chama testemunhas, ainda que a cidade já está entregue nas mãos dos caldeus.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio a palavra de Jeová a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר הֲ‍ֽמִמֶּ֔נִּי יִפָּלֵ֖א כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê kāl- bā·śār hămim·men·nî yip·pā·lê kāl- dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Behold I am the LORD the God of all flesh Is anything . . . too difficult for Me
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu sou Jeová, Deus de toda a carne; acaso há alguma coisa demasiado difícil para mim?

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ אֶת־ הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את בְּיַ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וּבְיַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯên ’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm ū·ḇə·yaḏ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says Behold I am about to deliver this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon who will capture it
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz Jeová: Eis que entregarei esta cidade nas mãos dos caldeus, e nas mãos de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, e ele a tomará.

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַנִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְהִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בָּאֵ֖שׁ וּשְׂרָפ֑וּהָ וְאֵ֣ת הַבָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ קִטְּר֨וּ עַל־ גַּגּֽוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לַבַּ֗עַל וְהִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū hak·kaś·dîm han·nil·ḥā·mîm ‘al- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·hiṣ·ṣî·ṯū ’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bā·’êš ū·śə·rā·p̄ū·hā wə·’êṯ hab·bāt·tîm ’ă·šer qiṭ·ṭə·rū ‘al- gag·gō·w·ṯê·hem lab·ba·‘al wə·his·si·ḵū nə·sā·ḵîm lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·ma·‘an haḵ·‘i·sê·nî
verses.literal: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come in set it on fire - and burn it along with the houses of those who provoked Me to anger by burning incense to Baal on their rooftops and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods
verses.literalPt: Os caldeus que pelejam contra esta cidade virão, atearão fogo a esta cidade e a queimarão, juntamente com as casas, sobre cujos eirados os seus habitantes têm oferecido incenso a Baal, e derramado libações a outros deuses, para me provocarem à ira.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָי֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אַ֣ךְ עֹשִׂ֥ים הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י מִנְּעֻרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַ֣ךְ מַכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛י בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ’aḵ ‘ō·śîm hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nay min·nə·‘u·rō·ṯê·hem kî ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’aḵ maḵ·‘i·sîm ’ō·ṯî bə·ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For . . . the children of Israel and of Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth indeed they . . . have done nothing but provoke Me to anger by the work of their hands declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pois os filhos de Israel e os filhos de Judá têm feito desde a sua mocidade tão somente o que era mau aos meus olhos; os filhos de Israel somente me têm provocado à ira com as obras das suas mãos, diz Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֧י עַל־ אַפִּ֣י וְעַל־ חֲמָתִ֗י הָ֤יְתָה לִּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְמִן־ הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לַהֲסִירָ֖הּ מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘al- ’ap·pî wə·‘al- ḥă·mā·ṯî hā·yə·ṯāh lî hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer bā·nū ’ō·w·ṯāh wə·‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh la·hă·sî·rāh mê·‘al pā·nāy
verses.literal: For this city has aroused My wrath . . . and fury . . . from the day it was built until now . . . . . . Therefore I will remove it from My presence
verses.literalPt: Esta cidade, desde o dia em que a edificaram até o dia de hoje, tem servido para provocar a minha ira e o meu furor a fim de que eu a remova de diante de mim,

verses.original: עַל֩ כָּל־ רָעַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְהַכְעִסֵ֔נִי הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִֽיאֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al kāl- rā·‘aṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lə·haḵ·‘i·sê·nî hêm·māh mal·ḵê·hem śā·rê·hem kō·hă·nê·hem ū·nə·ḇî·’ê·hem wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: because of all the evil the children of Israel and of Judah have done to provoke Me to anger they their kings their officials their priests and prophets the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: por causa de toda a maldade dos filhos de Israel e dos filhos de Judá, que eles praticaram para me provocarem à ira, eles, os seus reis, os seus príncipes, os seus sacerdotes, os seus profetas, os homens de Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛י עֹ֖רֶף וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וְלַמֵּ֤ד אֹתָם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְלַמֵּ֔ד וְאֵינָ֥ם שֹׁמְעִ֖ים לָקַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·nū ’ê·lay ‘ō·rep̄ wə·lō p̄ā·nîm wə·lam·mêḏ ’ō·ṯām haš·kêm wə·lam·mêḏ wə·’ê·nām šō·mə·‘îm lā·qa·ḥaṯ mū·sār
verses.literal: They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces Though I taught them again and again . . . they would not listen or respond to discipline
verses.literalPt: Voltaram-me as costas, e não o rosto; embora eu os ensinasse, levantando-me cedo e ensinando-os, contudo não escutaram para receberem instruções.

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָֽא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū šiq·qū·ṣê·hem bab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ā·lāw lə·ṭam·mə·’ōw
verses.literal: They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name and so have defiled it
verses.literalPt: Mas puseram as suas abominações na casa que é chamada do meu nome, para a profanarem.

verses.original: וַיִּבְנוּ֩ אֶת־ בָּמ֨וֹת הַבַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֗ם לְ֠הַעֲבִיר אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם֮ לַמֹּלֶךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְלֹ֤א עָֽלְתָה֙ עַל־ לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹעֵבָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לְמַ֖עַן הַחֲטִי אֶת־ יְהוּדָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·nū ’eṯ- bā·mō·wṯ hab·ba·‘al ’ă·šer bə·ḡê ḇen- hin·nōm lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·hem lam·mō·leḵ ’ă·šer lō- ṣiw·wî·ṯîm wə·lō ‘ā·lə·ṯāh ‘al- lib·bî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh haz·zōṯ lə·ma·‘an ha·ḥă·ṭī ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: They have built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to make their sons . . . and daughters pass through - the fire to Molech something I never commanded them nor had it ever entered . . . My mind that they should commit such . . . an abomination and cause Judah to sin
verses.literalPt: Edificaram os altos de Baal, que estão no vale do filho de Hinom, para fazerem que seus filhos e suas filhas passassem pelo fogo a Moloque: o que não lhes ordenei, nem entrou na minha mente, que fizessem esta abominação, para fazerem pecar a Judá.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לָכֵ֛ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־ הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִתְּנָה֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֥ב וּבַדָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ba·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·dā·ḇer
verses.literal: Now therefore about this city of which you say It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and plague this is what the LORD the God of Israel says
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel, acerca desta cidade, da qual vós dizeis: Já está entregue nas mãos do rei de Babilônia pela espada, pela fome e pela peste:

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י מְקַבְּצָם֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֛ם בְּאַפִּ֥י וּבַחֲמָתִ֖י וּבְקֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהֹשַׁבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mə·qab·bə·ṣām mik·kāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tîm šām bə·’ap·pî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî ū·ḇə·qe·ṣep̄ gā·ḏō·wl wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯîm ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·hō·šaḇ·tîm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: I will surely gather My people from all the lands to which I have banished them . . . in My furious anger . . . and great wrath and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety
verses.literalPt: Eis que os ajuntarei de todos os países para os quais os tenho arrojado na minha ira, e no meu furor, e em grande indignação; eu os tornarei a trazer para este lugar, e farei que habitem em segurança.

verses.original: וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lî lə·‘ām wa·’ă·nî ’eh·yeh lā·hem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: They will be My people and I will be their God
verses.literalPt: Eles serão o meu povo, e eu serei o seu Deus.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֜ם לֵ֤ב אֶחָד֙ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶחָ֔ד לְיִרְאָ֥ה אוֹתִ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים לְט֣וֹב לָהֶ֔ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem lêḇ ’e·ḥāḏ wə·ḏe·reḵ ’e·ḥāḏ lə·yir·’āh ’ō·w·ṯî kāl- hay·yā·mîm lə·ṭō·wḇ lā·hem wə·liḇ·nê·hem ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: I will give them one heart and one way so that they will always fear Me - . . . for their own good and for the good of their children after them
verses.literalPt: Dar-lhes-ei um só coração e um só caminho, para que me temam para sempre; a fim de que lhes vá bem a eles e a seus filhos depois deles;

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ אָשׁוּב֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם לְהֵיטִיבִ֖י אוֹתָ֑ם וְאֶת־ יִרְאָתִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י ס֥וּר מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·rat·tî lā·hem bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām ’ă·šer lō- ’ā·šūḇ mê·’a·ḥă·rê·hem lə·hê·ṭî·ḇî ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’eṯ- yir·’ā·ṯî ’et·tên bil·ḇā·ḇām lə·ḇil·tî sūr mê·‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: I will make an everlasting covenant with them I will never turn away from doing good to them - and I will put My fear in their hearts so that they will never turn away from Me
verses.literalPt: farei com eles uma aliança sempiterna de não me desviar deles, para lhes fazer o bem; e porei o temor de mim nos seus corações, para que não se apartem de mim.

verses.original: וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְהֵטִ֣יב אוֹתָ֑ם וּנְטַעְתִּ֞ים בָּאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת בְּכָל־ לִבִּ֖י וּבְכָל־ נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·śaś·tî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·hê·ṭîḇ ’ō·w·ṯām ū·nə·ṭa‘·tîm bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ be·’ĕ·meṯ bə·ḵāl lib·bî ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Yes , I will rejoice in doing them good and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul
verses.literalPt: Alegrar-me-ei sobre eles para lhes fazer o bem, e certamente os plantarei nesta cidade com todo o meu coração e com toda a minha alma.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֥ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את כֵּ֣ן אָנֹכִ֞י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer hê·ḇê·ṯî ’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh haz·zōṯ kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- kāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî dō·ḇêr ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this people so I will bring on them all the good I have promised them
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz Jeová: Assim como fiz vir sobre este povo todo este grande mal, do mesmo modo farei vir sobre eles todo o bem que eu lhes tenho prometido.

verses.original: וְנִקְנָ֥ה הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים שְׁמָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ מֵאֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ וּבְהֵמָ֔ה נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·nāh haś·śā·ḏeh bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm šə·mā·māh hî mê·’ên ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ hak·kaś·dîm
verses.literal: And fields will be bought in this land about which you are saying It is a desolation without man or beast it has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: Comprar-se-ão campos nesta terra, da qual vós dizeis: Erma é, sem homem nem animal; está entregue nas mãos dos caldeus.

verses.original: שָׂד֞וֹת בַּכֶּ֣סֶף יִקְנ֗וּ וְכָת֨וֹב בַּסֵּ֥פֶר׀ וְחָתוֹם֮ וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִים֒ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּבְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וּבְעָרֵ֥י הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֑גֶב כִּֽי־ אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ שְׁבוּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: śā·ḏō·wṯ bak·ke·sep̄ yiq·nū wə·ḵā·ṯō·wḇ bas·sê·p̄er wə·ḥā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·‘êḏ ‘ê·ḏîm bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min ū·ḇis·ḇî·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê hā·hār ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê han·ne·ḡeḇ kî- ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḇū·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Fields will be purchased with silver and deeds will be signed sealed and witnessed in the land of Benjamin in the areas surrounding Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah the cities of the hill country the foothills and the Negev because I will restore them from captivity declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Comprarão campos por dinheiro, e subscreverão os autos, e os selarão e chamarão testemunhas, na terra de Benjamim e nos lugares ao redor de Jerusalém, e nas cidades da região montanhosa, e nas cidades da Sefelá e nas cidades do Neguebe; porque farei voltar o seu cativeiro, diz Jeová.
